title: Chapter 702
text:
Han Xiao sized up the Dark-star leader and commented, "Your complexion seems much better."

"I heard that Godora's government is using extreme methods to deal with the bloodline conflict … and they're doing a much better job than me." The Dark-star leader's tone was complicated.

"From the perspective of a war criminal, you're quite well-informed," Han Xiao joked.

The Dark-star leader shook his head. "Do you know that I'm going to be executed soon?"

"Hmm?" Han Xiao's eyes moved. "Wasn't your punishment to be locked up indefinitely?"

"It was changed. It's probably a request from the Red Empire." The Dark-star leader sighed.

Han Xiao's eyes moved as he nodded slightly.

The Red Empire wanted to suppress Klent's crimes as soon as possible, so they naturally had to kill this important witness. Since the political deal had been completed, and the Dark-star leader had lost his value, Purple Crystal and Godora did not reject the Red Empire's request. Although the Dark-star leader was a Calamity Grade Super with research value, in the political casino between civilizations, he was only a slightly bigger chip.

What made him curious was that the Dark-star leader was very calm even though he knew that he was going to be executed.

"You don't hate me?"

Han Xiao was curious.

"If it was a few days ago, I would have hated you, but it's different now."

The Dark-star leader had a complicated expression. "I was once lost and made a deal with Klent, doing some dirty work for them. They promised to build a home for the Godora hybrids in the Flickering World in the future.

When I was caught by you, I thought that everything was over, but who would have thought … in the most desperate moment, I saw a real turning point.

Over the past few days, I have been reflecting on my past. The existence of DarkStar has made Godora realize the danger of the bloodline conflict. Getting rid of me, their mortal enemy, is the same as getting rid of their final obstacle. In order to prevent a second me from appearing, Godora has finally made up their mind to get rid of the bloodline conflict. While their method is different from mine, the Godoran government has done a much better job than mine.

Perhaps you don't believe me, but everything I do is to change the situation of mixed-bloods. It's just that my identity forces me to choose an extreme method. The future I look forward to is like a shadow of nothingness. No matter what I do, it's always far away. It's you who let me see that my beliefs aren't without hope, but that there's a price to pay … and that's my life.

"I don't hate you. If I wasn't caught by you, the Discrimination Transformation Movement would not have happened. If I could use my life to lay the foundation for my ideals, I would have no regrets. You made with my death."

The Dark-star leader's tone revealed a sense of relief and acceptance of his fate. He even revealed a faint smile.

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and remained unmoved. He slowly said, "You can be considered to have died a worthy death, but don't make yourself sound so noble. You're still a terrorist with a heavy debt of blood."

He would not pity a villain because of his last words of remorse. It was just an acceptance of fate. If the Dark-star leader had not been caught, even if he knew that surrendering could change the situation of the hybrids, this guy might not have been willing to give up his life.

"I know." The Dark-star leader lowered his eyes.

Han Xiao touched his chin and laughed. "However, your guess is wrong. Godora's determination to solve the bloodline conflict was not because of you. You are not as important as you think."

"Then why …" The Dark-star leader was puzzled. Could he have guessed wrong?

"To tell you the truth, the person who convinced Serbia the Fifth to promote the Discrimination Transformation Movement was me." Han Xiao raised his eyebrows.

The Dark-star leader's eyes widened. He could not remain calm. He suddenly stood up with a shocked expression.

He did not think that Han Xiao would come all the way to lie to him, a person who was about to die.

"Why did you help me …" The Dark-star leader's lips trembled.

Han Xiao clicked his tongue and said unhappily, "Help you? Do I know you that well? Don't think too highly of yourself. I have my reasons, but they have nothing to do with you. "

The Dark-star leader was silent. The person who caught him was Han Xiao, and the person who completed his ideals was also Han Xiao. His feelings were extremely complicated and tangled.

In the end, all the tangled feelings turned into a calm relief in the face of fate. It turned into a sincere thank you.

"Thank you."

Han Xiao was a little surprised. He nodded and did not say anything.

At this point, he felt that there was nothing more to talk about. He turned around and was about to leave the cell.

At this time, the Dark-star leader suddenly spoke.

"Please wait a moment. I have one last request, and it is also my only request."

Han Xiao stopped in his tracks and turned around in confusion. "What else do you want to say?"

The Dark-star leader slowly said, "You rose to power in just ten years. I have studied all your achievements, and I think that you have the bloodline of a warrior race. You can absorb a part of the opponent's abilities by killing them. That is why your strength improved so quickly."

"So?" Han Xiao narrowed his eyes.

This was not a secret, and he had never thought of hiding it. Those who were observant would naturally discover it. However, no one knew that it was because of the player interface. They would only attribute it to his talent.

The Dark-star leader took a deep breath.

"Rather than being executed by Godora, I would rather die in your hands. You are more qualified to judge me than them. Furthermore …" The Dark-star leader's tone was relieved. "This is the only thing I can give in return."

Han Xiao was shocked. A notification suddenly popped up on the interface.

You have triggered the Unique Hidden Mission [Dark-star Leader's Final Wish]!

Mission Introduction: You have destroyed the Dark-star, but you have also completed the mission of the Dark-star. The Dark-star leader wishes to die in your hands and offer his abilities to you.

Mission Requirements: Kill the Dark-star leader.

"A hidden mission …"

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled. He had once received a mission to defeat the Germinal Organization leader, and the reward was also two abilities. He had obtained a Molding Talent from it, and that was how he had started the path to becoming a boss.

The Dark-star leader was also a boss of a main storyline. This Unique Mission was a pleasant surprise of this trip, and it made his heart pound.

Han Xiao looked at him deeply. He raised his right hand, and more than ten lightning chain-like Mechanical Force shot out from his palm. They disappeared into the void and connected to the Blacklight Stealth warehouse far away at the dock. He then Apostilized the powerful mechanical soldiers in the warehouse.

An endless stream of energy flowed into Han Xiao's body through the Mechanical Force connection. His Energy Rank rose steadily, and his aura seemed to have solidified. Psionic energy bubbles appeared from his palm, highly compressed, and exuding a terrifying energy.

"I promise you," Han Xiao said with a deep voice.

The Dark-star leader let out a deep breath, dispelled the remaining energy defense in his body, and slowly closed his eyes.

…

Outside the cell, the warden was pacing back and forth, waiting for Han Xiao to come out.

At this time, a violent explosion suddenly came from the cell, and the entire prison seemed to shake!

Boom!

The warden was the closest, and his ears were almost deafened. His expression changed drastically, and he thought that an accident had happened. He hurriedly shouted, "Your Excellency Black Star, what happened to you …"

He called out to Han Xiao while opening the cell door. The moment the cell door was opened, he saw the situation inside, and his shout was stuck in his throat.

He saw broken limbs all over the floor, and the ground and walls were covered in blood and flesh. It was as if someone had exploded from the inside out. Han Xiao had a psionic shield in front of him, and the blood did not stain his body. A head was rolling on the ground. The warden took a closer look, and it was the Dark-star leader.

"You … you …" The warden was shocked.

"He begged me to kill him. Since you want to execute him anyway, let me do it for you."

Han Xiao deactivated his psionic shield, glanced at the warden, and walked out of the cell, leaving the warden in a daze.

The Dark-star leader was an important prisoner. Looking at the blood all over the floor, the warden did not know what to do. He asked his adjutant to receive Han Xiao on his behalf, and he endured the discomfort and hurriedly reported to his superiors.

The warden thought that he was going to be unlucky this time, but when his superiors heard that it was Han Xiao who did it, they did not have any intention of pursuing the matter.

With Han Xiao's current position in Godora, killing a death row prisoner was not a problem at all. Strength was privilege. Moreover, the Dark-star leader was Han Xiao's trophy, and Godora was not so pedantic. They would not destroy their good relationship with Han Xiao over such a small matter.

It could be said that in Godora, Han Xiao could almost do whatever he wanted.

The warden was secretly shocked by Han Xiao's influence. Afraid that his actions just now would make Han Xiao unhappy, he hurriedly rushed back to the dock and made it in time for the last journey. He sent Han Xiao onto the spaceship and watched him leave the prison.

…

Han Xiao set the spaceship on autopilot, then went to the training room, opened the interface to check the mission, and received the reward.

You have completed [Dark-star leader's Final Wish]!

You have received 15000 EXP!

You have received 1 Random Reward.

Han Xiao nodded. His current level was too high. Although 150,000,000 EXP was not a small amount, it was just a drop in the ocean.

He stored the Random Reward as usual. Now, there were a total of three Random Reward chances on the interface. He was very confident in his luck, so he planned to store them up and wait until he completed the [Bloodline] mission. The Mission Completion Card was not a rare reward, and he might not need to touch Ding to get one.

The final reward was the highlight.

You have received a reward: Draw two abilities (Skills/Talents) of the leader of the Dark-star organization.

Tip: The leader of the Dark-star organization is a Mage. Some of the abilities have been automatically adjusted according to your class.

Randomizing … Randomizing complete.

Please select one from the following five options as the reward:

1. [Advanced Free Element Affinity] – Talent: + 80% Energy Recovery Speed.

2. [Esoteric Training] – Talent: Your mind has traveled through 100 secondary dimensions and been baptized by spacetime. + 20% Mental Resistance, + 10% MYS, + 5% INT.

3. [Esoteric Vision] – Ability: + 25% MYS. Duration: 10 minutes. Cooldown: 25 minutes. Cost: 450 Energy.

4. [Painful Vengeance] – Ability: You can use pain to stimulate the potential of your cells and exert strength beyond your limit. Every time you lose 3% of your HP, you can use melee attacks to deal normal damage equivalent to 1.5% of your HP. Cost: 300 Energy.

The average quality of the abilities drawn this time is not bad … Han Xiao nodded.

The spells of Mages were driven by magic and were not compatible with those of Mechanics. Therefore, most of the spells could not be drawn. Only a small portion of the abilities could be adjusted and turned into a universal ability. This way, he could eliminate a large number of low-level spells of the Dark-star leader and increase the chances of drawing a good ability.
